#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    std::string s;
    std::cin >> s;
    int n = s.length();
    int count = 0, ans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ) {
        char c = s[i];
        int j = i;
        count = 0;
        while (j < n && s[j] == c) {
            count++;
            j++;
        }
        i = j;
        if (count % 2 == 0)
            ans++;
    }
    std::cout << ans << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
